shown.message:
I re-approved `paper-repo` PR #13 at 955af1f and closed `figtab-repo`#10.

- **Figures and tables:** `figures/` and `tables/` on the PR head match my `main` (05d22d4) exactly.
- **Built dev:** it is built from the same head, 955af1f. Its tables now number 1–11 without a gap, and `pdffonts` finds no Type 3 fonts. I did not re-view Fig. 4 this time, so its 7 pt size rests on the unchanged figure and placement.

The completed d-sweep added two longer-fit configurations (`fit2` and `fit10`) to `dsweep.csv`. My Table 11 does not show them, and the paper covers them in the appendix text. I left the table as it is.
